I found only these verified PubMed papers that report this disease or establish its genetic cause:

PMID 39148840 - Magrinelli F, 2025, Variants in the proteasome regulator PSMF1 cause a phenotypic spectrum from early-onset Parkinson's disease to perinatal lethality and disrupt mitochondrial function.

PMID 41986367 - Magrinelli F, 2026, Variants in the proteasome regulator PSMF1 cause a phenotypic spectrum from parkinsonism to perinatal lethality.

Notes:
- I verified the 2025 medRxiv preprint and the 2026 Nature Communications paper in PubMed.
- These appear to be the key papers linking PSMF1 to the disease spectrum that includes AMC8 / neurogenic arthrogryposis.
- I did not find any separate PubMed case reports or cohorts explicitly indexed under AMC8 beyond these PSMF1 disease papers.
